## [WORST EXPERIENCE OF MY LIFE WITH A COMPANY. The delivery service “metro delivery”…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/63ac66804d0773066a276465)
The delivery service “metro delivery” is extremely rude. Didn’t show up for two delivery’s. Then showed up and refused to bring the furniture out of the truck because it was “too heavy” and left. Then called me 25 times when we were in Italy demanding to deliver the furniture and would not take “no, we are not in the country” for an answer. They ruined 2 full days of our 10 year anniversary with their harassment until I finally turned off my phone. They could not get it delivered the first 3 times but no. They had to do it right then (so rude) and will not work around anyone’s schedule but their own. When we finally received the furniture they showed up with 2 people (after 5 phone calls confirming there would be 3 men to deliver). We had enough. They wouldn’t bring it to the bedroom (again with the it’s too heavy complaints). We had them drop it in the garage and I hired movers to move it to the bedroom. I would never ever ever purchase another piece of furniture from this company. They need to find a new source for their deliveries. All of this took place over many month with about 20 emails and too many phone calls to count. I don’t normally complain. This was over the threshold of ridiculous, rude, and harassing.

October 10, 2022

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Dec 29, 2022

Hi Leah,

We thank you for reaching out and we're sorry to hear about your experience with our delivery courier. We will forward this information to the appropriate teams to further review on this matter. If you have any further questions or concerns, please reach out to support@luluandgeorgia.com.
